 Uttarakhand Develops Silver Jubilee Parks Across Nine Urban Local Bodies 
 Star marking (1-5) indicates the importance of topic -->
 Why in News?   
 Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami inaugurated the Devbhoomi Silver Jubilee Parks in Rishikesh in November 2026 , as part of the state's 25 th Foundation Year celebrations.   
 Key Points   
 Coverage: The initiative covers nine urban local bodies across four districts: Dehradun, Haridwar, Udham Singh Nagar and Uttarkashi .   
 Park Facilities: The parks provide spaces for children's play, walking facilities for senior citizens, seating areas for women, and facilities for yoga and exercise.   
 Development Projects: Seven development projects worth over ₹36 crore were inaugurated or had their foundation stones laid in Dehradun district.   
 ODF Status: All 108 urban local bodies in Uttarakhand have achieved Open Defecation Free (ODF) status.   
 Water Plus Certification: Rishikesh and Haridwar have received Water Plus certification.   
 Treatment Plants: Under the sanitation plan, 27 Sewage and Faecal Sludge Treatment Plants are being established.   
 AMRUT: Under the first phase of the Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT) , 148 out of 151 approved projects have been completed, providing tap water connections to more than 72,000 households .   
 AMRUT 2.0: Projects worth around ₹650 crore are underway to provide drinking water to another 40,000 households and improve water bodies and ponds.   
 Digital Municipal Services: Services such as property tax payments, property mutation and trade licences are being made available online through the UPYOG platform .   
 Kumbh 2027: A digital sanitation monitoring system is being developed in Haridwar to improve cleanliness and waste management ahead of Kumbh 2027.   
 Read More: AMRUT , Kumbh 2027 , Open Defecation Free (ODF)

 Sonia Gandhi's Memoir 'Belonging: A Journey of Love' Released 
 Star marking (1-5) indicates the importance of topic -->
 Why in News?   
 The memoir of Sonia Gandhi , titled 'Belonging: A Journey of Love' , was released on November 10, 2026 .    
 Key Points   
 Author: The memoir has been written by Sonia Gandhi , senior Congress leader and former president of the Indian National Congress.   
 Publisher: It has been published by HarperCollins India .   
 Subject: The book explores Sonia Gandhi's journey from her Italian origins to becoming a prominent member of the Nehru-Gandhi family .   
 Personal Insights: It provides insights into the lives, motivations, struggles and personal experiences of members of the Nehru-Gandhi family.   
 Prime Ministership: Sonia Gandhi discusses her decision to decline the post of Prime Minister in 2004 , despite the Congress-led alliance's electoral victory.   
 Family: The memoir also discusses her family, including her husband Rajiv Gandhi and children Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra .

 President of India Presents Swachh Survekshan Awards 2025–26 
 Star marking (1-5) indicates the importance of topic -->
 Why in News?   
 President Droupadi Murmu presented the Swachh Survekshan Awards 2025–26 in New Delhi on 11 November 2026 . Organised by the Union Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) , the awards recognise India's cleanest cities and their contributions to the Swachh Bharat Mission–Urban .    
 Key Points:   
 Swachh Survekshan Awards 2025–26   
 Presented by: President of India, Droupadi Murmu in New Delhi.   
 Organising Ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.   
 Objective: To assess urban sanitation and cleanliness and recognise the performance of cities and urban local bodies.   
 Programme linkage: The awards recognise contributions towards the objectives of Swachh Bharat Mission–Urban .   
 Key Observations of the President   
 Cleanliness and public health: Cleanliness is not merely about maintaining the aesthetic appeal of public spaces; it also reflects public health, social consciousness and administrative accountability.   
 Citizen participation: Every citizen, household, community and city has a role in achieving cleanliness objectives.   
 Role of communities: Youth, women, Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs) and community organisations should actively participate in cleanliness initiatives.   
 Technology and Innovation in Sanitation   
 Affordable technologies: The President highlighted the need to develop effective, affordable and safe technologies for sanitation.   
 Research institutions: IITs and other scientific research organisations are contributing to technological development in the sanitation sector.   
 Start-ups: Sanitation-related start-ups can help address practical urban challenges while generating employment opportunities.   
 Innovation focus: Technology can improve sanitation services, waste management and the delivery of urban civic facilities.   
 Focus on Tier-2 and Tier-3 Cities   
 Rapid urbanisation: Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities are among India's fastest-growing urban centres.   
 Capacity building: The President called for special attention to strengthening their institutional and administrative capacities.   
 Context-specific planning: Their development strategies should address their distinct requirements and local challenges.   
 Learning from larger cities: Planners in smaller urban centres can learn from the experiences and challenges faced by Tier-1 cities.   
 Swachh Bharat Mission–Urban   
 Launch: 2 October 2014.   
 Nodal Ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.   
 Objective: To improve sanitation, eliminate open defecation and promote scientific solid waste management in urban areas.   
 Major components:   
 Construction of individual household, community and public toilets.   
 Scientific processing and management of municipal solid waste.   
 Behavioural change and public awareness.   
 Capacity building of urban local bodies.   
 Swachh Bharat Mission–Urban 2.0: Launched on 1 October 2021.   
 Focus areas of SBM-U 2.0: Garbage-free cities, sustainable sanitation, source segregation, scientific waste processing and remediation of legacy dumpsites.   
 Swachh Survekshan   
 Launched: 2016.   
 Organising agency: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.   
 Purpose: To assess and rank urban areas on cleanliness and sanitation-related parameters.   
 Assessment approach: Includes indicators relating to sanitation infrastructure, solid waste management, cleanliness outcomes and citizen participation.   
 Significance: Encourages competition among urban local bodies and promotes improvements in municipal service delivery.   
 Read More: Swachh Bharat Mission–Urban

 M. John Harrison Wins Booker Prize 2026 for ‘The End of Everything’ 
 Star marking (1-5) indicates the importance of topic -->
 Why in News?   
 British writer M. John Harrison has won the 2026 Booker Prize for his novel The End of Everything . At 81 years of age , he has become the oldest-ever recipient of the prestigious literary award.    
 Key Points:   
 Booker Prize 2026   
 Winner: M. John Harrison, British novelist and critic.   
 Winning novel: The End of Everything .   
 Award ceremony: Old Billingsgate, London, on 9 November 2026 (local time); the winner was announced on 10 November in India.   
 Record: At 81, Harrison became the oldest winner in the history of the Booker Prize.   
 Literary milestone: It is the first science-fiction novel to win the Booker Prize.   
 About ‘The End of Everything’   
 Genre: Satirical, dystopian and science-fiction novel.   
 Themes: Catastrophe, apocalypse, uncertainty, human understanding and the boundaries between genres.   
 The Booker Prize Foundation described it as a satirical and unsettling post-apocalyptic adventure.   
 Booker Prize   
 Established: 1969.   
 Purpose: Recognises the best eligible novel written in English and published in the UK or Ireland.   
 Eligibility: Open to writers of any nationality, subject to the prize's publication and eligibility rules.   
 Previous winner (2025): David Szalay for Flesh .   
 Significance: The prize is among the most prominent literary awards for English-language fiction and often brings international recognition to its winners.
